title.narrative: UNITAD - Building Investigative & Analytical Capacity of Iraqi Civil Society
UNITAD - Uppbyggnad av utrednings- & analyskapacitet i civila samhället Irak

description.narrative:
This project titled "Building Investigative and Analytical Capacity of Iraqi Civil Society", supports two key priority areas of UNITAD: 1. Establishing a locally staffed electronic discovery team. 2. Supporting Civil Society Organisations for the preservation and exploitation of evidence related to ISL crimes against minorities and vulnerable groups.
The project will have a vital relevance for UNTIAD's filed activities and the management of evidence. Tackling the abovementioned priorities will directly contribute to broadening and enriching UNITAD's corpus of information, which may be responsive to requests from third-party states. This will ultimately make a difference for the promotion of accountability in Iraq, as it will contribute to increasing the number of successful prosecutors of ISL members of crimes against humanity, war crimes and genocide.
Moreover, the project will have a positive impact on the promotion of peaceful coexistence, an inclusive society and transitional justice, as it will deal with specific communities and vulnerable populations (including minorities and women) while ensuring accountability for crimes committed by ISIL. Moreover, it will contribute to strengthening human rights, democracy, the rule of law and gender equality while supporting civil society. With the foreseen activities, the project will also contribute to the implementation of the 2030 Agenda (Sustainable Development Goals)

UNITAD is mandated to "support domestic efforts to hold ISIL members accountable by collecting, preserving and storing evidence pertaining to acts that may amount to, war crimes, crimes against humanity and genocide committed by ISIL in Iraq". To implement its mandate, UNITAD works in close collaboration with civil society actors, representatives of affected communities and minorities in Iraq as well as with different NGOs and other national stakeholders. The project "Building the Investigative and Analytical Capacity of Iraqi Civil Society" aims to strengthen local civil society capacity through the two project areas: 1) establishing a locally staffed electronic discovery team, and 2) supporting civil society organizations for the preservation and exploitation of evidence related to ISIL crimes against minorities and vulnerable groups.

UNITADs mandat är att stödja irakiska ansträngningar att hålla ISIL-medlemmar ansvariga genom att samla in, bevara och lagra bevis som rör handlingar begångna av ISIL i Irak, t.ex. krigsförbrytelser, brott mot mänskligheten och folkmord. För att genomföra sitt uppdrag arbetar UNITAD nära irakiska civilsamhällesaktörer, representanter för drabbade samhällsgrupper och minoriteter. Även med olika icke-statliga organisationer och andra nationella intressenter. Projektet "Building the Investigative and Analytical Capacity of Iraqi Civil Society" syftar till att stärka det lokala civilsamhällets kapacitet genom de två projektområdena: 1) upprättande av ett lokalt bemannat team för elektronisk upptäckt, och 2) stödja civilsamhällets organisationer för bevarande och exploatering av bevis relaterade till ISILs brott mot minoriteter och utsatta grupper.
